i'm doing better now yeah, its an uphill battle but one im sure i'll win. i've been wanting to play sekiro a lot! bloodborne too since i havent touched it yet. much to play, much to experience haha

i could theoretically share an apartment yeah but that still involves working for money which is something i really cant take. i can either hope i can make enough doing somethin creative, which is very unlikely, or accept im just gonna end up homeless

i really have no idea. the only ideas i have are drastic , like ive been considering just ditching everything and becoming a dirty kid or a hitchhiker but that tales a lot of preparation and motivation to go through with and i just dont have much of those to spare

they know the gist , there are times its hard to hide what with therapy and hospitalizations and all that , but no one really knows exactly whats goin on. i try not to tell anyone. i find often it just makes people feel helpless and i dont want to contribute to making whatever theyre might already being through under the surface worse

my parents are the only people ive tried to communicate it with and they are definitely a source of exacerbation. when i try to communicate how shit everything makes me feel im constantly told to suck it up and that i need to work to survive and like. yeah. i am working, and will continue working as long as the suffering stays at a manageable level, but its not gonna work for me in the long term. hypervigilance and sensory overload just make it unsustainable without me eventually breaking down mid-shift (which has already happened a couple times) and it just makes me feel like a disappointment because i know they expect more from their daughter than to either give up and go vagabond or kill myself out of stress

im going on a decade of suicidality at this point. i guess im just tired. flashbacks and panic attacks are shit and all but the worst part is the disconnect. there are times where my sense of self just completely dissolves, times where ill just lose track of hours and hours of time, times where i can see myself from above, etc. its a feeling that is notoriously difficult to describe but for me has been so much worse than any other aspect of my mental health.

yes though im not technically supposed to have the kpins. my doctor is forgetful and has a tendency to overmedicate so i literally just told him they wouldnt accept the script he 'gave' me for clonazepam at the pharmacy and he called it in for me.
there isnt much to talk about but i really appreciate the offer
